en: Power Management Bus. An open, SMBus/I²C-based command protocol for configuring, controlling and monitoring power converters. Part I covers transport and electrical; Part II defines the command set and data formats (LINEAR11, LINEAR16, DIRECT, VID).
zh: 電源管理匯流排。基於 SMBus/I²C 的開放式命令協定，用於設定、控制與監控電源轉換器。Part I 定義傳輸與電氣規格；Part II 定義命令集與資料格式（LINEAR11、LINEAR16、DIRECT、VID）。

sources.title: PMBus specifications (pmbus.org)

en: System Management Bus. A two-wire bus derived from I²C with tighter timing (e.g. clock-low timeout), optional Packet Error Checking and an alert line (SMBALERT#). PMBus runs on top of SMBus.
zh: 系統管理匯流排。源自 I²C 的雙線匯流排，時序規範較嚴格（例如 clock-low timeout），支援選用的封包錯誤檢查（PEC）與警示腳位 SMBALERT#。PMBus 建構在 SMBus 之上。

sources.title: SMBus specification (smbus.org)

en: An optional CRC-8 byte (polynomial x⁸ + x² + x + 1, 0x07) appended to SMBus/PMBus transactions, computed over all bytes including the address bytes.
zh: 選用的 CRC-8 檢查位元組（多項式 x⁸ + x² + x + 1，即 0x07），附加在 SMBus/PMBus 交易後，計算範圍涵蓋位址在內的所有位元組。

en: PMBus 16-bit linear format for most non-output-voltage values. Bits [15:11] are a 5-bit two's-complement exponent N; bits [10:0] are an 11-bit two's-complement mantissa Y. Value X = Y · 2^N.
zh: PMBus 用於大部分非輸出電壓參數的 16 位元線性格式。位元 [15:11] 為 5 位元二補數指數 N；位元 [10:0] 為 11 位元二補數尾數 Y。實際值 X = Y · 2^N。

sources.title: TI UCD90320 – Distinguishing between linear data formats

en: PMBus format for output-voltage commands (VOUT_COMMAND, READ_VOUT, …). The 16-bit word is an unsigned mantissa V; the exponent N comes from the lower 5 bits of VOUT_MODE (two's complement). Value X = V · 2^N.
zh: PMBus 輸出電壓相關命令（VOUT_COMMAND、READ_VOUT 等）所用格式。16 位元字組為無號尾數 V；指數 N 取自 VOUT_MODE 的低 5 位元（二補數）。實際值 X = V · 2^N。

en: One-byte PMBus command describing how output-voltage values are encoded. Bits [7:5] select the mode (000 = Linear, 001 = VID, 010 = Direct, 011 = IEEE half precision in PMBus 1.3+); bits [4:0] are the parameter (the exponent in Linear mode, the VID code type in VID mode).
zh: 描述輸出電壓數值編碼方式的單位元組 PMBus 命令。位元 [7:5] 選擇模式（000 = Linear、001 = VID、010 = Direct、011 = IEEE 半精度，PMBus 1.3 以後）；位元 [4:0] 為參數（Linear 模式時為指數，VID 模式時為 VID 碼型）。

sources.title: TI TPS546C23 – VOUT_MODE (20h)

en: PMBus format where the device publishes coefficients m (slope), b (offset) and R (exponent). Encode: Y = (m·X + b) · 10^R. Decode: X = (Y · 10^−R − b) / m. Y is a 16-bit two's-complement integer.
zh: PMBus 的一種資料格式，裝置提供係數 m（斜率）、b（偏移）與 R（指數）。編碼：Y = (m·X + b) · 10^R；解碼：X = (Y · 10^−R − b) / m。Y 為 16 位元二補數整數。

sources.title: PMBus – Direct Data Transfer Format (APEC 2017)

en: PMBus block-read command that returns the m, b and R coefficients a device uses for a given command in DIRECT format.
zh: PMBus 區塊讀取命令，回傳裝置在 DIRECT 格式下某命令所使用的 m、b、R 係數。

en: A coded output-voltage setting defined by the processor vendor (e.g. Intel VR12/VR13, AMD SVI). The code-to-voltage table depends on the VID type selected in VOUT_MODE.
zh: 由處理器廠商定義的輸出電壓編碼（例如 Intel VR12/VR13、AMD SVI）。編碼與電壓的對應表取決於 VOUT_MODE 所選的 VID 類型。

zhTerm: 自適應電壓調整匯流排
en: Adaptive Voltage Scaling Bus, added in PMBus 1.3. A fast point-to-point 3-wire interface (clock, data in, data out) that lets a load such as an ASIC or FPGA adjust its supply voltage in real time.
zh: 自適應電壓調整匯流排，於 PMBus 1.3 加入。高速點對點三線介面（時脈、資料輸入、資料輸出），讓 ASIC、FPGA 等負載即時調整供電電壓。

en: Fixed-point notation: m integer bits (excluding sign) and n fractional bits in a signed two's-complement word. Resolution is 2^−n; range is −2^m to 2^m − 2^−n. Example: Q15 (Q0.15) in 16 bits spans −1 to 0.99997.
zh: 定點數表示法：在有號二補數字組中，m 個整數位元（不含符號位）與 n 個小數位元。解析度為 2^−n；範圍為 −2^m 至 2^m − 2^−n。例如 16 位元的 Q15（Q0.15）範圍為 −1 至 0.99997。

en: Representing fractional numbers as scaled integers so that a controller without an FPU can run control loops quickly. Multiplying two Q-numbers adds their fractional bits, so results must be shifted back and checked for overflow.
zh: 以縮放後的整數表示小數，讓沒有 FPU 的控制器也能快速執行控制迴路。兩個 Q 格式數相乘時小數位數相加，因此結果需右移還原並檢查溢位。

en: TI library and convention for 32-bit fixed-point math on C2000 MCUs, where a global Q value (GLOBAL_Q, typically 24) sets the fractional bits of the _iq type.
zh: TI 在 C2000 MCU 上使用的 32 位元定點運算函式庫與慣例，以全域 Q 值（GLOBAL_Q，通常為 24）決定 _iq 型別的小數位數。

en: Limiting a value to its representable or allowed range instead of letting it wrap around on overflow. Essential for duty cycle, integrator state and compensator outputs.
zh: 數值溢位時將其限制在可表示或允許的範圍內，而不是讓它回繞。對佔空比、積分器狀態與補償器輸出都非常重要。

en: A PWM generator driven by a counter clocked at f_clk. The number of counts per switching period sets duty-cycle resolution: N_bits = log₂(f_clk / f_sw) for up-count mode (one bit less for up-down count).
zh: 由 f_clk 驅動之計數器所產生的 PWM。每個開關週期的計數數量決定佔空比解析度：上數模式 N_bits = log₂(f_clk / f_sw)（上下數模式少 1 位元）。

en: The smallest duty-cycle (or time) step a PWM can produce. Time step = 1/f_clk (or the HRPWM step); duty step = time step × f_sw. For a buck converter the output voltage step is roughly V_in × duty step.
zh: PWM 能產生的最小佔空比（或時間）步階。時間步階 = 1/f_clk（或 HRPWM 步階）；佔空比步階 = 時間步階 × f_sw。對 Buck 轉換器而言輸出電壓步階約為 V_in × 佔空比步階。

en: PWM hardware that places edges with sub-clock-cycle precision, typically using delay lines (e.g. TI C2000 micro-edge positioner, ~150 ps steps). It raises effective resolution at high switching frequencies.
zh: 能以小於一個時脈週期的精度放置 PWM 邊緣的硬體，通常以延遲線實現（例如 TI C2000 的 MEP，步階約 150 ps）。可在高開關頻率下提高有效解析度。

en: Alternating the duty cycle between adjacent DPWM levels over several switching periods so the average duty has finer resolution than the hardware step. Increases effective resolution at the cost of low-frequency ripple.
zh: 在數個開關週期間交替使用相鄰的 DPWM 階層，使平均佔空比的解析度高於硬體步階。可提升有效解析度，代價是出現低頻漣波。

sources.title: Peterchev – Digital Control of PWM Converters (UC Berkeley EECS-2006-146)

en: The voltage represented by one ADC code: LSB = V_ref / 2^N. Referred to the converter output through a divider of gain k, the output-voltage LSB is V_ref / (2^N · k).
zh: ADC 一個碼所代表的電壓：LSB = V_ref / 2^N。若經增益為 k 的分壓器回授，對應到輸出電壓的 LSB 為 V_ref / (2^N · k)。

en: A small-range, high-resolution ADC that digitises only the difference between the reference and the feedback voltage (used in TI UCD controllers). It gives fine resolution around the set point without needing a high-bit ADC.
zh: 只數位化參考電壓與回授電壓差值的小範圍高解析 ADC（用於 TI UCD 控制器）。不需高位元 ADC 即可在設定點附近取得精細解析度。

en: Effective Number Of Bits: the resolution an ADC actually delivers once noise and distortion are included. ENOB = (SINAD − 1.76 dB) / 6.02 dB.
zh: 有效位元數：考慮雜訊與失真後 ADC 實際提供的解析度。ENOB = (SINAD − 1.76 dB) / 6.02 dB。

en: A steady-state oscillation in a digitally controlled converter caused by quantization in the ADC and DPWM. A necessary condition (Peterchev & Sanders, 2003) is that the output-voltage step of one DPWM LSB is smaller than the ADC LSB referred to the output, and the loop has integral action. This is necessary, not sufficient.
zh: 數位控制轉換器中，由 ADC 與 DPWM 量化所造成的穩態振盪。必要條件（Peterchev & Sanders, 2003）為：一個 DPWM LSB 造成的輸出電壓步階須小於換算到輸出端的 ADC LSB，且迴路具有積分作用。此為必要條件而非充分條件。

sources.title: Peterchev & Sanders, Quantization resolution and limit cycling in digitally controlled PWM converters (IEEE TPEL 2003)
Univ. of Toronto – limit cycle analysis

en: Two-pole/two-zero discrete compensator, the digital counterpart of an analog Type II. Difference equation: u[n] = B0·e[n] + B1·e[n−1] + B2·e[n−2] − A1·u[n−1] − A2·u[n−2].
zh: 兩極點／兩零點離散補償器，對應類比 Type II。差分方程式：u[n] = B0·e[n] + B1·e[n−1] + B2·e[n−2] − A1·u[n−1] − A2·u[n−2]。
formula: H(z) = (B0 + B1 z⁻¹ + B2 z⁻²) / (1 + A1 z⁻¹ + A2 z⁻²)

sources.title: Microchip – Digital Compensators (2P2Z & 3P3Z)

en: Three-pole/three-zero discrete compensator, the digital counterpart of an analog Type III, used where extra phase boost is needed (e.g. voltage-mode buck with an LC double pole).
zh: 三極點／三零點離散補償器，對應類比 Type III，用於需要更多相位提升的場合（例如具 LC 雙極點的電壓模式 Buck）。
formula: H(z) = (B0 + B1 z⁻¹ + B2 z⁻² + B3 z⁻³) / (1 + A1 z⁻¹ + A2 z⁻² + A3 z⁻³)

sources.title: TI – Digital power supply considerations for the analog engineer (SPRY151)

zhTerm: Type II 補償器（第二型）
en: Analog compensator with an origin pole, one zero and one high-frequency pole. Gives up to 90° of phase boost; typical for current-mode control.
zh: 具原點極點、一個零點與一個高頻極點的類比補償器。最多提供 90° 相位提升，常用於電流模式控制。

zhTerm: Type III 補償器（第三型）
en: Analog compensator with an origin pole, two zeros and two high-frequency poles. Gives up to 180° of phase boost; typical for voltage-mode control.
zh: 具原點極點、兩個零點與兩個高頻極點的類比補償器。最多提供 180° 相位提升，常用於電壓模式控制。

en: Proportional-Integral-Derivative control. In digital power the derivative is usually filtered, which makes a discrete PID equivalent to a 2P2Z.
zh: 比例-積分-微分控制。在數位電源中微分項通常會加上濾波，使離散 PID 等效於 2P2Z。

en: Maps a continuous transfer function to discrete time by substituting s = (2/T)·(z − 1)/(z + 1). It preserves stability; frequency warping can be corrected by pre-warping at a chosen frequency.
zh: 以 s = (2/T)·(z − 1)/(z + 1) 將連續時間轉移函數轉換為離散時間。可保持穩定性；頻率扭曲可藉由在選定頻率預扭曲（pre-warping）修正。

en: Time from ADC sampling to the PWM update, plus the PWM's own zero-order-hold effect. Each delay T_d adds phase lag of 360°·f·T_d, which limits achievable crossover frequency.
zh: 從 ADC 取樣到 PWM 更新所經過的時間，加上 PWM 本身的零階保持效應。每個延遲 T_d 會增加 360°·f·T_d 的相位落後，限制可達成的穿越頻率。

en: Crossover f_c is where loop gain equals 0 dB; phase margin is 180° plus the loop phase at f_c. Digital loops typically target f_c ≤ f_s/10 because of sampling delay; 45°–60° phase margin is common.
zh: 穿越頻率 f_c 為迴路增益等於 0 dB 處；相位裕度為 180° 加上 f_c 處的迴路相位。由於取樣延遲，數位迴路通常設定 f_c ≤ f_s/10；常見相位裕度為 45°–60°。

en: Stops the integrator from accumulating when the output is saturated (e.g. duty at its limit), avoiding large overshoot when the converter leaves saturation.
zh: 在輸出飽和時（例如佔空比到達上限）停止積分器累加，避免轉換器離開飽和時產生大幅過衝。

en: Ramping the reference voltage from zero to the target over a set time (PMBus TON_RISE) to limit inrush current and overshoot.
zh: 在設定時間內（PMBus TON_RISE）將參考電壓由零逐步升至目標值，以限制湧入電流與過衝。

en: Continuous vs. Discontinuous Conduction Mode. In CCM the inductor current never reaches zero; in DCM it does, changing the converter's small-signal model and gain.
zh: 連續與不連續導通模式。CCM 時電感電流不會降到零；DCM 時則會，因而改變轉換器的小信號模型與增益。

en: In an ideal buck in CCM, D = V_out / V_in. Therefore one DPWM duty step ΔD changes V_out by about V_in · ΔD.
zh: 理想 Buck 在 CCM 時 D = V_out / V_in。因此每一個 DPWM 佔空比步階 ΔD 約造成 V_in · ΔD 的輸出電壓變化。

en: A single central supply generates every output rail and delivers them to the loads through cables and bus bars. Simple, but low-voltage, high-current rails suffer large distribution losses and poor transient response at the load.
zh: 由單一中央電源產生所有輸出電壓，經由電纜與匯流排送到各負載。架構簡單，但低電壓、大電流的電源軌在配電路徑上損耗大，負載端的暫態響應也差。

en: Few parts, simple design
One place to cool and monitor
zh: 零件少、設計簡單
散熱與監控集中在一處

en: High I²R loss for low-voltage rails
Slow load transients
Single point of failure
zh: 低壓電源軌 I²R 損耗高
負載暫態響應慢
單點故障

sources.title: Mouser – The Modern Distributed Power Architecture

en: A front end distributes a relatively high bus voltage (e.g. 48 V or 300 V) across the system, and isolated, regulated DC/DC converters ("bricks") near each load produce the final rails. Lower distribution current and easier expansion, at the cost of many isolated converters.
zh: 前級在系統中配送較高的匯流排電壓（例如 48 V 或 300 V），再由靠近各負載的隔離式穩壓 DC/DC 轉換器（「磚型模組」）產生最終電壓。配電電流較小、擴充容易，但需要大量隔離式轉換器。

en: Low distribution current
Easy to add rails
Fault in one converter does not take down the rest
zh: 配電電流低
容易增加電源軌
單一轉換器故障不影響其他

en: Many isolated converters: cost and board area
Each brick needs its own regulation and protection
zh: 需要多個隔離式轉換器，成本與面積高
每個模組都需自己的穩壓與保護

sources.title: DigiKey – Distributed Power Architecture (DPA) Choices Using Power Modules

en: A two-stage refinement of DPA. One isolated bus converter (often unregulated or semi-regulated, fixed ratio) turns 48 V into a 12 V, 9.6 V or 5–8 V intermediate bus; non-isolated point-of-load (niPOL) bucks then regulate each rail. The dominant architecture in telecom, servers and networking boards.
zh: DPA 的兩級式改良。一個隔離式匯流排轉換器（常為非穩壓或半穩壓、固定比例）將 48 V 轉為 12 V、9.6 V 或 5–8 V 的中間匯流排，再由非隔離的負載點（niPOL）Buck 轉換器分別穩壓各電源軌。是通訊、伺服器與網通板卡最主流的架構。

en: Only one isolated stage
Cheap, plentiful POL bucks
Easy to add rails
zh: 只需一級隔離
POL Buck 便宜且選擇多
容易增加電源軌

en: Two conversion stages multiply losses
Intermediate bus voltage is a compromise between distribution loss and POL step-down ratio
zh: 兩級轉換使損耗相乘
中間匯流排電壓需在配電損耗與 POL 降壓比之間取捨

sources.title: Electronic Design – What's the difference between IBA and FPA?
MPS – Two-stage solution for 48 V power distribution

en: The first stage of an IBA: an isolated converter, often a fixed-ratio (e.g. 4:1 or 8:1) DC transformer (DCX) running near 50 % duty for high efficiency. Unregulated types let the bus follow the input; semi-regulated or regulated types narrow the bus range for the POLs.
zh: IBA 的第一級：隔離式轉換器，常為固定比例（例如 4:1 或 8:1）的直流變壓器（DCX），以接近 50% 佔空比運作以取得高效率。非穩壓型的匯流排電壓隨輸入變動；半穩壓或穩壓型則縮小匯流排範圍，方便後級 POL。

en: A non-isolated converter, usually a synchronous buck, placed right next to the load (CPU, FPGA, ASIC, DDR) so the low-voltage, high-current path is as short as possible. Digital POLs add PMBus telemetry, sequencing and margining.
zh: 非隔離轉換器（通常為同步 Buck），放在負載（CPU、FPGA、ASIC、DDR）旁，使低電壓、大電流路徑盡量短。數位 POL 另提供 PMBus 遙測、上電時序與電壓邊際調整功能。

en: Splits the converter into a regulator and a transformer: a pre-regulator (PRM) creates a controlled "factorized bus", and a fixed-ratio current multiplier (VTM) at each load does isolation and step-down. Aimed at very high-current, low-voltage loads. Introduced by Vicor; vendor efficiency and density claims should be checked independently.
zh: 把轉換器拆成「穩壓」與「變壓」兩部分：前級穩壓器（PRM）產生受控的「因式分解匯流排」，再由每個負載旁的固定比例電流倍增器（VTM）負責隔離與降壓。適用於極大電流、低電壓的負載。由 Vicor 提出；廠商宣稱的效率與功率密度數據建議另行驗證。

en: Current multiplication right at the load
Regulation and isolation sized independently
zh: 電流在負載端才倍增
穩壓與隔離可分別最佳化

en: Largely single-vendor ecosystem
Feed-forward regulation across the VTM ratio
zh: 生態系多半依賴單一廠商
需跨越 VTM 變比做前饋穩壓

sources.title: DigiKey – Factorized Power Architecture (FPA)

zhTerm: 48 V 直接轉負載點（單級）
en: Converts the 48 V rack bus (e.g. OCP Open Rack) directly to ~1 V at the processor in one stage, usually with a transformer-based or hybrid switched-capacitor topology. Removes the intermediate bus; competes with two-stage 48 V → 12 V (or 5–8 V) → 1 V solutions.
zh: 將 48 V 機櫃匯流排（例如 OCP Open Rack）以單一級直接轉為處理器所需的約 1 V，通常採用含變壓器或混合式切換電容拓撲。省去中間匯流排；與兩級式 48 V → 12 V（或 5–8 V）→ 1 V 方案互相競爭。

en: One stage, no intermediate bus
Lower distribution current than 12 V racks
zh: 單一級、無中間匯流排
配電電流比 12 V 機櫃低

en: Very high step-down ratio is hard to do efficiently with a plain buck
Less mature, fewer standard parts than two-stage
zh: 極高降壓比難以用一般 Buck 高效實現
成熟度與標準零件數量不如兩級式

sources.title: TI – 48 V power architecture comparison (SSZTB19)
Flex – Power architectures: a direct approach is more efficient

en: The control loop stays analog; a digital block (an on-chip engine or a separate housekeeping MCU / power sequencer) handles configuration, sequencing, margining, fault logging and PMBus telemetry. Keeps proven analog loop behavior while adding observability.
zh: 控制迴路仍為類比；由數位電路（晶片內引擎或獨立的管理 MCU／電源時序控制器）負責設定、上電時序、電壓邊際、故障記錄與 PMBus 遙測。保留成熟的類比迴路特性，同時提升可觀測性。

en: Analog loop bandwidth and no quantization effects
Adds telemetry to existing designs
zh: 類比迴路頻寬高、無量化效應
可為既有設計加上遙測

en: Compensation still set by external R/C
Extra parts if the manager is a separate chip
zh: 補償仍需外部 R/C 設定
若管理器為獨立晶片則需額外零件

sources.title: Power Systems Design – Digital power supply control

zhTerm: 數位控制電源（數位迴路）
en: The feedback loop itself is digital: an ADC (or error ADC) samples the output, a digital compensator (PID / 2P2Z / 3P3Z) computes the duty cycle, and a DPWM drives the switches. Enables adaptive and non-linear control and programmable compensation, but brings sampling delay and quantization (see limit cycles).
zh: 回授迴路本身為數位：ADC（或誤差 ADC）取樣輸出，數位補償器（PID／2P2Z／3P3Z）計算佔空比，再由 DPWM 驅動開關。可實現自適應與非線性控制、補償參數可程式化，但會引入取樣延遲與量化效應（見極限環）。

en: Programmable compensation, no R/C changes
Adaptive, non-linear and multi-mode control
Built-in telemetry
zh: 補償可程式化，不必更換 R/C
可做自適應、非線性與多模式控制
內建遙測

en: Sampling and computation delay limit bandwidth
ADC/DPWM resolution and limit cycles
Firmware and tooling effort
zh: 取樣與運算延遲限制頻寬
ADC／DPWM 解析度與極限環問題
需投入韌體與工具開發

sources.title: TI – Digital control seminar (Topic 7)
Control Engineering – Convert power with digital signal controllers

en: A general-purpose digital signal controller (e.g. TI C2000, Microchip dsPIC33, ST STM32G4) runs the control loop in firmware using on-chip high-resolution PWM, fast ADCs and comparators. Most flexible option: any topology or control law, plus PFC, communications and housekeeping on one chip.
zh: 以通用數位訊號控制器（例如 TI C2000、Microchip dsPIC33、ST STM32G4）在韌體中執行控制迴路，搭配晶片內的高解析 PWM、高速 ADC 與比較器。彈性最高：任何拓撲或控制法則皆可實現，並可在同一顆晶片上整合 PFC、通訊與系統管理。

en: Any topology / control law
One chip for loop, PFC and comms
zh: 可實現任何拓撲與控制法則
迴路、PFC 與通訊整合於一顆晶片

en: Loop rate limited by CPU cycles
Requires firmware development and validation
zh: 迴路更新率受 CPU 週期限制
需開發與驗證韌體

sources.title: element14 – Benefits of digitally controlled DC power

zhTerm: 固定功能／狀態機控制器
en: A dedicated digital power IC whose loop runs in hardware (filter blocks, state machines) and is configured through registers or PMBus with a vendor GUI rather than user firmware. Examples include TI UCD and ADI ADP105x families. Fast to design in, but limited to the topologies the chip supports.
zh: 專用的數位電源 IC，控制迴路由硬體（濾波器區塊、狀態機）執行，透過暫存器或 PMBus 搭配廠商 GUI 設定，而非使用者韌體。例如 TI UCD 與 ADI ADP105x 系列。導入快速，但僅限晶片支援的拓撲。

en: No firmware to write
Hardware loop runs at high sample rates
zh: 不需撰寫韌體
硬體迴路取樣率高

en: Limited to supported topologies and features
Tied to the vendor's design tool
zh: 受限於支援的拓撲與功能
依賴廠商設計工具

sources.title: Analog Devices – Designing digital power supplies with a state machine

en: The control loop is implemented as parallel logic in an FPGA, giving deterministic, very short loop latency and sub-nanosecond PWM via delay lines. Common in research, high-frequency GaN/SiC converters and multi-level inverters; needs HDL skills and external ADCs.
zh: 控制迴路以 FPGA 中的平行邏輯實現，延遲固定且極短，並可藉延遲線產生次奈秒等級的 PWM。常見於研究、高頻 GaN／SiC 轉換器與多階逆變器；需要 HDL 能力並搭配外部 ADC。

en: Lowest, deterministic latency
Massive parallelism for multi-phase / multi-level
zh: 延遲最低且固定
高度平行，適合多相／多階

en: HDL design effort
Higher cost and power than a DSC
zh: 需投入 HDL 設計
成本與功耗高於 DSC

en: Controller that drives several interleaved buck phases (with smart power stages) for CPU/GPU/AI-accelerator rails. Digital loops add phase shedding, current balancing, AVS/SVID/SVI3 interfaces, non-linear transient response and PMBus telemetry.
zh: 驅動多個交錯 Buck 相位（搭配智慧功率級）的控制器，用於 CPU、GPU 與 AI 加速器電源軌。數位迴路提供相位增減、電流平衡、AVS／SVID／SVI3 介面、非線性暫態響應與 PMBus 遙測。
